title: Sampling-based Estimation of the Number of Distinct Values in Distributed Environment

problem.claim: Estimate the number of distinct values in data mining, including in distributed environments.

gap.claim: Sampling-based NDV estimation is less practical in distributed environments because transferring the entire sample can incur prohibitive communication costs.

contributions.claim: A sketch-based distributed method for sampling-based NDV estimation with sub-linear communication costs under mild assumptions.
A sketch-based algorithm estimates the sample's frequency of frequency in the distributed streaming model and is compatible with most classical sampling-based NDV estimators.
The paper provides theoretical evidence that the method minimizes communication costs in the worst-case scenario.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors explicitly present their sketch-based distributed method as novel.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Extensive experiments show orders-of-magnitude savings in communication costs compared with existing sampling- and sketch-based methods.

narrative_sequence.summary: NDV estimation is a fundamental data-mining problem with various applications.

NDV estimators include scanning-based methods and sampling-based methods; scanning-based methods trade lower approximation error for higher I/O and time, while sampling-based methods offer scalability when some error is permissible.
Sampling-based estimation is less practical in distributed environments because transferring the full sample creates prohibitive communication costs.
The paper proposes a sketch-based distributed method that estimates sample frequency of frequency with sub-linear communication costs.
The authors report worst-case theoretical communication-cost minimization and orders-of-magnitude experimental savings.

source_observation.claim: Transferring the entire sample across a distributed system can dominate the cost of sampling-based NDV estimation.

interpretation.claim: Distributed estimation should reduce communication volume rather than only optimize local estimation computation.

application.claim: Use compact sketches to summarize distributed samples before communication when the application permits bounded estimation error.

exception.claim: The proposed communication guarantee is stated under mild assumptions, and the abstract does not specify their scope.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the mild assumptions underlying the sub-linear communication guarantee.
The abstract does not provide estimator formulas, approximation-error bounds, datasets, experimental settings, or quantitative communication-cost results.
